basic_info.description: Step into this beautifully updated Westlake Highlands home and discover the perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience. Thoughtfully upgraded throughout, it features a modern kitchen with cosmetic nods to yesteryear, three fully remodeled bathrooms, and flexible living spaces including a formal living room and a cozy den off the kitchen designed for both gatherings and quiet nights in. Bedrooms span three of the four levels, offering privacy and flexibility for office space or guests. Outside, a landscaped backyard invites gardening and relaxation. Upgrades include all-new electrical, EV charging in the garage, 2 year old roof and move-in ready finishes throughout. Just blocks from Westlake Shopping Center and minutes to San Francisco, Silicon Valley, and top employers like Genentech, Amgen, Google, and YouTube, this location combines suburban calm with unbeatable access. With BART, 101 & 280 nearby, plus excellent schools and recreation, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy modern living in one of Daly City's most sought-after neighborhoods.
